main_text.p: טְמֵאִים immundi, pl. m. No. טְמֵא ; Rad. טָמֵא .
טְמֵאת immunda, f. fæm. constr. No. טְמֵאָה, Rad. טָמֵא .
טָמְאָתוֹ impuritas, ejus, מִטָּמְאוֹת ab immundiciis, טָמְאוֹתָם immundicies eorum, f. fæm. constr. aff. & pl. fæm. præf. & aff. No. טְמֵאָה ; Rad. טָמֵא .
לִטְמוֹן ad abscondendum, לִטְמֹנוֹ eum, טְמָנִים abscondeo eos, Infin. Kal, præf. & aff. ut & Imper. f. m. aff. R. טָמַן .
טָנָאךְ corbis tuus, f. m. aff. No. Rad. טָנָא .
טָעֹם gustando, טָעֲמוּ gustate, Infin. Kal, & Imper. pl. m. Rad. טַעַם .
טַעְמוֹ sapor ejus, No. sing. masc. טַעַם, aff. Rad. טַעַם gustavit.
טְעֲנוּ onerate, Imper. Kal, pl. m. R. טָעַן .
הַטַּף parvuli, טַפָּם ipsorum, טַפְּכֶם vestri, טַפֵּנוּ nostri, No. f. m. aff. Rad. טַפַּף .
טְפוֹף incedere incessu parvulorum, Infin. Kal, Rad. טָפַף .
טָרֵד continuans, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. טָרַד .
לִטְרָף discerpendo, מְרוּף [?] ad rapiendum, טֹרֵף discerptus est, vel טָרֵף discerptus, Infin.Kal, præf. & præt. 3. f. m. & part.Ben.Pual, ut & טְרֻפָּה laceratum, No. f. fæm. Rad. טָרַף .
לִטְרָחָה in fatigationem, טִרְחֲכֶם molestia ve-stra,

page.notes: Hebrew forms are copied from the scan at small size; forms marked [?] are doubtful. The section letters ט נ, ט ע, ט פ, ט ר are bare Hebrew letters and are set as paragraphs. The running heads are the Hebrew column headers over each column, written as they appear on the page. No catchword or signature is printed. The last line of the right column is cut off at the column end, so "ve-stra," ends there.
